class.name: WorldBurnScar3D
class.brief_description: An old burn authored into a scene, as the fire contract reports it.
class.description: Ground that burnt [member age_years] before the scene's present. It joins the fire contract as a producer while in the tree, so [method WorldFire.burn_age_at] gives its age over its area, and the vegetation grows back to the matching stage. The area is [member polygon] when it has three or more points, else a [member size] rectangle centred on the node; both follow the node's transform. Where scars overlap, the most recent burn wins.

method.name: get_area
method.description: The scar's bounds in world x, z (metres). The scar reports this area to [method WorldFire.burn_changed] when it enters or leaves the tree, moves, or its age, size or polygon change.

method.name: covers
method.description: Whether [param position] (world space) lies over the scar.

members.member: How burnt the ground is over the scar, 0 to 1: the share of the fuel the old fire took. [method WorldFire.burnt_at] answers it over the scar's area whatever its age; readers weigh the recovery by [method WorldFire.burn_age_at].
The scar's outline in the node's local x and z, metres. Fewer than three points: [member size] is used.
The rectangle's width along local x and depth along local z, metres.
